title: Whale eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Snack: small fish shape in front of whale mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='52' rx='9' ry='4.5' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <polygon points='91,52 98,47 98,57' fill='#ff8c00'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='50.5' r='1.4' fill='#3b1f00'/>
  <!-- Whale body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='55' rx='34' ry='21' fill='#4a90d9'/>
  <!-- Belly (lighter shade of own colour) -->
  <path d='M14 60 Q45 80 76 60 Q45 74 14 60 Z' fill='#a8d4f5'/>
  <!-- Mouth opening -->
  <path d='M66 50 Q74 55 66 60 Q60 55 66 50 Z' fill='#14345c'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M12 55 Q2 42 4 55 Q2 68 12 55 Z' fill='#4a90d9'/>
  <path d='M12 55 Q4 50 4 55 Q4 60 12 55 Z' fill='#7fb8e8'/>
  <!-- Fin -->
  <path d='M42 74 Q48 88 56 72 Q50 76 42 74 Z' fill='#3a78c0'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='48' r='2' fill='#10233f'/>
  <!-- Blowhole spray -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='31' r='3' fill='#c9e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='27' r='2.2' fill='#c9e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='27' r='2.2' fill='#c9e8ff'/>
</svg>
